name: 属性名・演算子・値・削除・追加を持つ条件チップ
prompt:
Edit the existing LH09-0247 image to make a tight horizontal export of the filter-condition chip. The source crop is 249x33 (7.55:1); the first output contains the correct chip but has a 1956x804 canvas with large blank margins. Remove the surrounding blank canvas so the rounded chip and separate plus control fill the entire image vertically and horizontally. Target an output around 2048x271 (7.55:1), with no more than a few pixels of white margin at the edges. Do not return a square or 3:1 canvas.

Keep the chip's exact existing Japanese text and segment structure: priority-bars icon + 「優先度」, operator 「が」, priority-bars icon + 「高」, remove x, then separate plus. Preserve the rounded outline, light gray separators, icon shapes, color, typography and spacing. Keep all content on one horizontal line, with the chip's top and bottom borders fully visible. Do not change the wording or add surrounding interface.
reviewNotes: v002 preserves all chip contents and boundaries, but remains 2051x767 (2.674:1) versus the 249x33 source (7.545:1) with large margins after the targeted reframe. Needs-correction after two attempts.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
